extracted.summary: The Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students provides financial assistance to SC students from Class 11 to Ph.D. level across India.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual family income of less than INR 2.5 lakhs.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Caste category as determined by the state/union territory (UT).
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary level i.e. Class 11 to Ph.D. level.
extracted.deadline_quote: Scholarship Closing Date - 30th April 2022. The status shown on the page is Closed.
